headline: Asian Stocks Decline on Fed Stance and Earnings; Samsung Falls 4.1%
summary: Asian bourses closed mostly lower following the Federal Reserve's rate decision and corporate earnings. South Korea's Kospi dropped 1.24%, led by a 4.1% fall in Samsung Electronics despite strong earnings.
why: Asian equities reflect global demand cycles for technology hardware, semiconductors, and regional macroeconomic health.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Shares dropped 4.1% despite solid quarterly results as broader market sentiment soured.

why_moved: Asian equity benchmarks tracked lower as traders absorbed central bank policy guidance and sold off major tech names like Samsung.
